Fest. (Lewis & Short)

oscillō, oscillāre

verb, first conjugation, intransitive

swing oneself, swing to and fro

Traupman explicitly records this on pp. 53 and 389; Lewis & Short cites Festus. No unverified perfect or supine is supplied. For gentle back-and-forth movement of a person, Tē hūc illūc movē. remains the descriptive prompt in our Monkey Tree Game.

Examples

  • Vīsne oscillāre?

    Do you want to swing?composed

See also swing, swing, pump, hang, Monkey Tree Game / arm / branch / hanging / swinging.

SourcesLewis & Short: oscillo

Traupman (fourth edition)
